reasoning.step1:
Plan:
- Verify document is an invoice (presence of "RECHNUNG", invoice number, date, totals).
- Identify sender VAT (UID-Nr near sender) vs other UIDs (Auftraggeber/Rechnungsempfänger).
- Locate invoice date and grand total labels ("Fakturabetrag" / totals).
- Extract net amount and VAT amount from the summary block labeled "Nettowert" and "UST".
- Extract VAT rate from "UST %".
- Ensure no inference: if a field is ambiguous/missing, leave empty.

Findings/evidence:
- Invoice indicators: Title "RECHNUNG", invoice number "4391267699", dates present ("06.10.2023", "03.10.2023", "05.10.2023") — primary invoice date appears next to invoice number as "06.10.2023".
- Sender block: "Mondelez Österreich GmbH" with "UID-Nr   ATU    35980300" — treat as Sender.VatId = "ATU35980300" (no inference beyond reading).
- Summary block shows:
  - "Bruttowert 765,46" (not required by schema)
  - "Nettowert 448,88" -> Net.Amount = 448,88
  - "UST 44,89" -> Vat.Amount = 44,89
  - "inkl.UST 493,77" and "Fakturabetrag 493,77 EUR" -> GrandTotal.Amount = 493,77
  - "UST % 10,00" -> Vat.Rate = 10 (per rule remove % symbol)
- Confirm numeric formatting: document uses comma decimals; final numeric values must preserve decimal places (three fields have two decimals).
- No contradictory multiple sender VATs in sender header; other UIDs (ATU22642807) are Auftraggeber/Rechnungsempfänger and must not be used as Sender.VatId.

Conclusion for extraction:
- Invoice.Date: "06.10.2023"
- Sender.VatId: "ATU35980300"
- GrandTotal.Amount: 493,77
- Net.Amount: 448,88
- Vat.Amount: 44,89
- Vat.Rate: 10

No other required fields inferred; all values taken directly from text.
